posts.title: Alibi
posts.description: "She is highly paid to make hard decisions." A virtue, almost? But what does hard mean? A hard decision can be to choose between two of your favorite chocolate bars. Low stakes, that. If you love both you'll be happy either way. A hard decision can also be an easy one to make in theory, but one that has real consequences. posts.title: Santa exists... right(?)
posts.description: She is six. The question comes every couple of months. Often in the middle of us talking about something very concrete , like what she is going to wear to school tomorrow. "Dad. Santa exists… right(?)" "Right" is the key part of that sentence. The question mark is almost silent. She is not really inquiring, wants flat-out reassurance. It's a ritual. Call-and-response.
